fields.name: id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the reservation.

fields.name: confirmation_code
fields.description: The human-readable confirmation code for the reservation.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The current status of the reservation.

fields.name: listing_id
fields.description: The identifier of the listing that was booked.

fields.name: nights
fields.description: The total number of nights in the reservation.

fields.name: guests_count
fields.description: The number of guests included in the reservation.

fields.name: total_price
fields.description: The total price of the reservation in the listing currency.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: The ISO 4217 currency code for the reservation pricing.

fields.name: host_payout
fields.description: The amount to be paid out to the host after fees.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The timestamp when the reservation was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: The timestamp when the reservation was last updated.
